## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Gemini chat completions now return an empty JSON object (`{}`) when a tool call omits its arguments or provides empty arguments. This applies to both streamed and non-streamed responses, so the arguments can be parsed as valid JSON. Tool calls with provided arguments remain unchanged. Gemini chat conversions now emit `{}` when a function call omits arguments in non-streaming and streaming responses. Unit tests and end-to-end cases cover both paths. **Changes: Gemini tool-call argument conversion** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Default arguments in chat conversions**
